name: Notes page linked to a video
description: A white browser window of a study-notes page (lock + path in the URL bar, no domain or logo) with the speaker live in a round face bubble on its corner: an orange mono label, a big title that gets a marker swipe, 2-4 note lines that write in one by one, then a dark timestamp chip ('▶ 04:12') pops beside each note; a cursor clicks the first chip and a dark video player under the notes jumps its progress bar to that moment.
use_when: Lines about notes, docs or a study page, especially notes that link back to a video, lecture or course (timestamps, 'it references the video itself').

url.help: a path, not a real domain

notes.help: [{text, time}] note lines (<= 30 characters) with an optional video timestamp like '04:12'

notes_at.help: seconds from the scene start when the notes start writing in

link_at.help: seconds from the scene start when the timestamp chips and the player appear

pip.help: the speaker's round face bubble on the window's corner
